en-US.author: Eh
en-US.description: Build, Create, and Publish Modrinth Modpacks with eh's modpacks for no reason
en-US.longDescription: Does Nothing then create ModPacks for Modrinth by making it as a project
en-US.name: ehmodpack
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fixed:
- The modrinth token can no longer get you stuck, instead it will delete it if it is invalid
- new-from-mrpack no longer fails with a 400 when a pack pins a file by version number instead of id, it resolves the version now
Changed:
- Visting contents of a mod, shader, datapack or resource pack will give you a way to add it to your project right away
